act_name: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
heading: Amendment of section 2, Ordinance XVII of 2002
title: Amendment of section 2, Ordinance XVII of 2002
text:
2.
Amendment of section 2, Ordinance XVII of 2002.— In the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002 (XVII of 2002), hereinafter referred to as “the said Ordinance”, in section 2, for clause (ii), the following shall be substituted, namely:—

“(ii) “Chairman” means the person appointed as Chairman of the Authority and includes the Vice-Chairman when acting as Chairman or the Civil Servant to whom the additional charge of the post of Chairman is assigned;”

2. 
Amendment of section 2, Ordinance XVII of 2002.— In the Oil 
and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002 (XVII of 2002), hereinafter 
referred to as “the said Ordinance”, in section 2, for clause (ii), the following 
shall be substituted, namely:— 
 
 
“(ii) “Chairman” means the person appointed as Chairman of the

act_name: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
heading: Amendment of section 3, Ordinance XVII of 2002
title: Amendment of section 3, Ordinance XVII of 2002
text:
3.
Amendment of section 3, Ordinance XVII of 2002.— In the said Ordinance, in section 3, in sub-section (8), in clause (a), for the semi colon, at the end, a colon shall be substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be inserted, namely:—

“Provided that in case the post of Chairman is vacant for the time being, the Federal Government may assign the additional charge of the post of Chairman to a civil servant of BS-21 or above, who is otherwise eligible for the post and is not posted in the Petroleum Division at the relevant time, for a period of three months or until the appointment of a regular Chairman, whichever is earlier.”

ASIF ALI ZARDARI, President

————

RAJA NAEEM AKBAR, Secretary
